verdicts.reason: A breaks the design: the pink panel is gone, so the white 'YOUR SPACE' sits on a light grey wall with almost no contrast. 'EXPAND' has dropped below the headline, which breaks the reading order. A stray red rectangle covers the lamps and chairs, and the zigzag and triangle rows are mangled and clumped at the bottom. B keeps the original's panel, chevrons and type order, but the panel starts below a grey strip at the top and ends above a bare floor strip at the bottom, so it looks unanchored and not full-bleed, and the left chevrons are cropped awkwardly.
